title: CheXpert Plus: Augmenting a Large Chest X-ray Dataset with Text Radiology Reports, Patient Demographics and Additional Image Formats

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring representational bias by analyzing and reporting the frequency distribution of patient race and ethnicity metadata in the dataset to enable future auditing of model performance disparities.
Measuring representational bias by analyzing and reporting the frequency distribution of patient sex metadata in the dataset to enable future auditing of model performance disparities.
Measuring representational bias by analyzing and reporting the frequency distribution of patient age groups in the dataset to enable future auditing of model performance disparities.

Measuring representational bias by analyzing and reporting the frequency distribution of patient insurance types (e.g., Medicare, Medicaid, Private) in the dataset to enable future auditing of model performance disparities.
Measuring representational bias by reporting the frequency distribution of patients who require a language interpreter to enable the evaluation of models on diverse patient populations.
Measuring representational bias by reporting the frequency distribution of patient Body Mass Index (BMI) in the dataset to enable auditing of diagnostic model robustness across different body types.
